alerts.name: Cross Site Scripting (Reflected)
alerts.description: Cross-site Scripting (XSS) is an attack where malicious scripts are injected into trusted websites.
alerts.solution: Ensure that all user-supplied data is appropriately context-encoded before rendering in HTML.

alerts.name: Anti-CSRF Tokens Check
alerts.description: No Anti-CSRF tokens were found in a HTML submission form.
alerts.solution: Phase in Anti-CSRF tokens for sensitive state-changing forms.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps detect and mitigate attacks.
alerts.solution: Ensure that your web server transmits the Content-Security-Policy header.

alerts.name: Storable and Cacheable Content
alerts.description: The response contents are storable by caching components such as proxies.
alerts.solution: Review Cache-Control directives for sensitive endpoints.
